999008199.text:
私がおせちを作るなら、ですか……
やっぱりお団子を入れたいです！　色は紅白にします！

localizations.en: If I were to make osechi myself... I'd definitely want to include dango! And I'd make them red and white!

999008199.text:
込める願いは……そうですね。
お団子は丸いので、「福徳円満」とかどうでしょうか

localizations.en: As for the wish I'd put into them... Let's see. Since dango are round, how about 'perfect happiness and prosperity'?

999008199.text:
錬金術を復興して、その力で皆さんが
福徳円満、幸せになるお手伝いができたらいいなって！

localizations.en: I hope that by reviving alchemy, I can use its power to help everyone achieve perfect happiness and prosperity!

999008199.text:
よかったら、あなたの願いも教えてください！
あなたなら、おせちに何を入れますか？

localizations.en: If you don't mind, please tell me your wish too! What would you include in your osechi?
